description: Signed-in Pro or Firm attorneys only. How the attorney's cases imported: queued (the Pro Workspace has not been opened since; it imports within a minute of opening thecompdesk.com/workspace), imported (with the figures the workspace computed), needs_review (for example the attorney edited that tab, so newer data waits for their decision) or rejected (with codes). Pass keys like "G1234567:2026-10-22" (WCB number:hearing date), or nothing for every recent import. Receipts are kept 48 hours.
name: get_import_status
